title: DOQS product-family catalogue
description: Maps commercial SKU names to a composition module plus a parametric model. Lives as catalog.toml at the root of a family repository. Module folders keep functional slugs; commercial names appear only here, so pricing sheets can join without dictating folder names.

family.description: Slug of the product family this catalogue describes.

name.description: Commercial catalogue id, e.g. ALS-SL-500. Uppercase, so it never reads like a module slug.

composition.description: Family-root-relative path of the composition module.

model.description: Parametric model slug declared by the composition's core module.
